|translation='''Title:''' Echo Base Trooper Officer.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Echo Base Troopers deploy for 1 less at the same location. Your troopers may move as a react to the same Hoth location as the officer.

'''Lore:'''
Most Rebel specialists are former Imperial officers who defected, as Trey Callum did. Trooper officers excel at making good use of the Rebellion’s scarce supplies.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses location in both clauses where the English uses site.
